lines: 坚守所教真实的道理，
就能将纯正的教训劝化人，
又能把争辩的人驳倒了。
Keeping to the true word of the teaching
so that he may be able to give comfort by right teaching and overcome the arguments of the doubters.
好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，
谨守，贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得神的道理被毁谤。
Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,
To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
谨守，贞洁，料理家务，
待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，
免得神的道理被毁谤。
To be wise in mind
clean in heart
kind; working in their houses
living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样，
在教训上要正直、端庄，
In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching
serious in behaviour
你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样，在教训上要正直、端庄，
言语纯全，无可指责，叫那反对的人，既无处可说我们的不是，便自觉羞愧。
In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching, serious in behaviour,
Saying true and right words, against which no protest may be made, so that he who is not on our side may be put to shame, unable to say any evil of us.
分门结党的人，警戒过一两次，就要弃绝他。
因为知道这等人已经背道，犯了罪，自己明知不是，还是去作。
A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;
Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.
不要毁谤，不要争竞，
总要和平，向众人大显温柔。
To say no evil of any man
not to be fighters
to give way to others
to be gentle in behaviour to all men.
他便救了我们，
并不是因我们自己所行的义，
乃是照他的怜悯，
借着重生的洗和圣灵的更新。
Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves
but in the measure of his mercy
he gave us salvation
through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit
无用的牧人丢弃羊群有祸了！刀必临到他的膀臂和右眼上。他的膀臂必全然枯干；
他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
A curse on the foolish keeper who goes away from the flock! the sword will be on his arm and on his right eye: his arm will become quite dry and his eye will be made completely dark.
那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。
And it will come about on that day that I will take in hand the destruction of all the nations who come against Jerusalem.
地上万族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王万军之耶和华的，
必无雨降在他们的地上。
And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King
the Lord of armies
on them there will be no rain.
「万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。
不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」
This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your judging be upright and done in good faith, let every man have mercy and pity for his brother:
Do not be hard on the widow, or the child without a father, on the man from a strange country, or on the poor; let there be no evil thought in your heart against your brother.
耶和华你的神是施行拯救、大有能力的主。他在你中间必因你欢欣喜乐，
默然爱你，且因你喜乐而欢呼。
The Lord your God is among you
as a strong saviour: he will be glad over you with joy
he will make his love new again
he will make a song of joy over you as in the time of a holy feast.
那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语，
好求告我耶和华的名，
同心合意的事奉我。
For then I will give the people a clean language
so that they may all make prayer to the Lord and be his servants with one mind.
